---
title: "Social platforms"
execute:
  eval: true
---

The chart below shows the 15 social platforms with the most monthly active users, colored by owning company. The code reads the data cleaned in [clean_social.qmd](clean_social.qmd) and plots it.

```{r}
#| label: fig-social
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: "Top 15 social platforms by monthly active users"
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

social_top15 <- read_csv("data/social_platforms_clean.csv") |>
  slice_max(mau_millions, n = 15)

ggplot(social_top15, aes(
  x = fct_reorder(name, mau_millions),
  y = mau_millions,
  fill = company_group
)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Meta Platforms" = "#8dc63f", "Alphabet Inc." = "#c62828",
    "ByteDance" = "#f2a71b", "Tencent" = "#2e86c1",
    "Microsoft" = "#4a3b57", "Other" = "grey70"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Monthly active users (millions)", fill = "Company",
    title = "The most popular social platforms, and who owns them"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
